q: The Indian National Congress was founded in which year?
exp: The Indian National Congress was founded in 1885 by A.O. Hume. Answer: 1885
Bhagat Singh popularised 'Inquilab Zindabad' (Long Live the Revolution). Answer: Bhagat Singh

q: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre took place in which city?
exp: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre occurred in Amritsar on 13 April 1919. Answer: Amritsar

q: Who founded the Indian Home Rule Society in London?
exp: Shyamji Krishna Varma founded the India House / Home Rule Society in London in 1905. Answer: Shyamji Krishna Varma

q: The Non-Cooperation Movement was launched by Mahatma Gandhi in which year?
exp: The Non-Cooperation Movement was launched in 1920. Answer: 1920

q: Who was the first Governor-General of independent India?
exp: Lord Mountbatten was the first Governor-General of independent India (1947–48). Answer: Lord Mountbatten

q: The Quit India Movement was launched in which year?
exp: The Quit India Movement was launched on 8 August 1942. Answer: 1942

q: Who was the President of the Constituent Assembly of India?
exp: Dr. Rajendra Prasad was the President of the Constituent Assembly. Answer: Dr. Rajendra Prasad

q: The Partition of Bengal was implemented by which Viceroy?
exp: Lord Curzon implemented the Partition of Bengal in 1905. Answer: Lord Curzon

q: Who founded the Servants of India Society in 1905?
exp: Gopal Krishna Gokhale founded the Servants of India Society in 1905. Answer: Gopal Krishna Gokhale

q: The Dandi March (Salt Satyagraha) was started on which date?
exp: The Dandi March began on 12 March 1930 from Sabarmati Ashram. Answer: 12 March 1930

q: Who was the last Viceroy of India?
exp: Lord Mountbatten was the last Viceroy of India (until June 1948). Answer: Lord Mountbatten

q: The Champaran Satyagraha (1917) was related to which issue?
exp: The Champaran Satyagraha was against the oppressive indigo (tinkathia) system. Answer: Indigo plantation

q: Who was the first Indian recipient of the Bharat Ratna award (1954)?
opts: Dr. S. Radhakrishnan, C. Rajagopalachari and S. Chandrasekhar
exp: In 1954, Dr. S. Radhakrishnan, C. Rajagopalachari and Dr. S. Chandrasekhar were the first three Bharat Ratna recipients. Answer: Dr. S. Radhakrishnan, C. Rajagopalachari and S. Chandrasekhar

q: The Hindustan Socialist Republican Association (HSRA) was founded in which year?
exp: HSRA was founded in 1928 at Feroz Shah Kotla, Delhi, by Bhagat Singh, Chandrashekhar Azad and others. Answer: 1928
